name: Fritos The Original Corn Chips
whyItWorks: Contains just three simple ingredients: corn, corn oil, and salt. The corn is cooked, finely ground, and extruded before frying, completely eliminating whole kernels and sharp hulls.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Enjoy in moderation during remission. Because of oil content, chew thoroughly and avoid eating on an empty stomach during active flares.
